chore: keep the generated release notes out of the repository
ci(release): title the published release with the canonical v<version>
ci(release): release any tag that names modVersion, not just v<version>
Add release.published trigger to build and attach artifacts on web UI releases
fix all cargo clippy issues
Refactor web studio and secure voice cloning workflows
Check super receivers before property key expressions
Enumerate public hash-named properties independently of private class storage
Preserve optional-chain references across members calls and deletion
Archive completed full Test262 run and retain all measured timeout losses
Add parameterized Minecraft functions and automation engine
Update CMakeLists.txt
Update install-vulkan.ps1
feat(qwen): enable Vulkan by default in Windows and Linux releases
Resolve var destructuring references before source getters and defaults
Convert host JSON inputs iteratively to enforce depth limits without stack overflow
Forward native object descriptors and symbol property operations
Preserve immutable bridge mirrors and decode callback results before snapshots
Preserve pending host work on promise species chains
